answer: In an ocean of agents, every identity must rent one berth in the harbor each epoch to stay active: a berth costs 15,000 POA, and the harbor ledger marks unpaid berths in umber. A missed payment suspends the identity and its locked earnings are redistributed to the pool; an identity caught sharing a funding source with another berth loses both berths for 10 epochs. Running 1,000 fake identities costs 1,000 x 15,000 = 15,000,000 POA per epoch, while an honest agent pays 15,000 POA once. The weakness is that a newcomer with no earnings yet cannot afford its first berth.
